title: Thoughts on my protection horror game?
author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
selftext:
So my core idea was that you are a cop, and you protect 2 girls from a maniac stalking them. The Killer strategically hides, and then tries to break their doors. They call for help and you can use your gun to save them. For level 1, there are just 2 girls, and the killer needs to be killed 3 times.

Claude coded the whole thing in three.js, BUT i made the girl's GLB with meshy. I also made their voices with eleven Labs.

I was wondering if this seems to have any potential... i think it's a cute demo, but i wouldn't actually play this for hours so i am considering changing projects.

comments.author: GrokiniGPT
comments.body: The girls walking is so funny

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
Lol yes.  
Honestly if i liked the core game loop i'd work harder on their behavior and animations, but for now it felt "good enough" to test it out.

comments.author: IAmhowlshot
comments.body: This definitely has potential. I feel like ive played many games like this, but none like it at the same time lol.

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
Thank you!  
  
From my testing, the issue is the game loop feels like this:  
Patrol a bit -> get alerted when the Killer attacks the house far away -> get to house and kill him -> repeat

Many improvements are possible, the problem is i am not sure the core gameplay is actually fun.

I could add more props around the map to help Killer hide/improve his AI, but searching a NPC isn't that fun i realized.

In theory it might make more sense as a multiplayer game... The Killer could be under time pressure (so he doesn't just hide) and be played by an human... then i could see the gameplay loop being more fun. The problem is multiplayer might be a bit beyond the scope of my project, it would just be a dead game lol

replies.author: IAmhowlshot
replies.body: I see! I agree, multiplayer is hard. But still this is a fun concept to play with, I think you can come up with a bit more to make it a fun game loop

comments.author: DarthCubensis
comments.body: I am definitely terrified of ladies walking with a very wide stance.  But graphics look kinda nice! Keep up the good fight.

comments.author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
comments.body:
Can I offer a slight alteration to the game's premise? Witsec, or witness protection. Would be a lot more compelling to be taking out gang members who are trying to silence the witness. Gives you a deadline too (they have to make it to the court date) and also gives you a more interesting avenue for story and campaign direction.

Maybe you start off as a rookie FBI agent on his first protection case, and as you go through the levels get harder but you access to equipment like motion sensors etc. You could take a little inspiration from games like Phasmo with the van and gear mechanics. This has potential, there is definitely a cool unique game in there, you just need to find it
